title: Re-Banning the Re-Banished: Levels 1 & 2
description: Re-Banning the Re-Banished: Levels 1 & 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Ready to head out again and lay the lay down on the Banned Farmers? You really showed them last time! Except they came back for more, so maybe you didn't really show them anything....

Same deal; make your way to Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2. They are all infested and need to be cleared out again. Also, we need you to collect more golded vegetables for our tests. Ban the farmers and collect the required vegetables then return to me, Yakov Smearnov, in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You must be some kind of machine. Some sort of macro operated bot with a really sweet GUI, or something! Let me know when you are ready to try again.

Objectives:

  • Farm on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Farm on Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Farm on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Golded Pumpkins ×15
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×30

Level range: 78–79
